description: Extension of OnboardingView providing the pages and UI logic for onboarding and setup flows in the OpenClaw macOS application, including gateway configuration, permissions, CLI installation, workspace setup, onboarding chat, and final readiness screen.

methods.name: pageView
methods.description: Returns a specific onboarding page view based on the page index.

methods.name: welcomePage
methods.description: Displays a welcome page with security notice and introductory information.

methods.name: connectionPage
methods.description: Guides the user through selecting connection gateway options and discovery.

methods.name: permissionsPage
methods.description: Displays permissions approval UI for macOS permissions required by OpenClaw.

methods.name: cliPage
methods.description: Provides instructions and UI for installing the OpenClaw CLI.

methods.name: workspacePage
methods.description: Guides setup of the agent's workspace directory and related commands.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage
methods.description: Shows the onboarding chat interface for user-agent interaction.

methods.name: readyPage
methods.description: Final page indicating setup completion, with actions and feature highlights.
